posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
It is not necessary to make one post after another, you can edit the message and add additional information. I will try to help you.
Your game being RMVXAce will not work directly in the browser, only RMMV, RMMZ and VNMZ games can be deployed in web browsers. So in this case you need to compress your project through RPG Maker through its "File" menu, it will generate an executable extractor for Windows.
(Enable the Include RTP option)
In Itch.io you must:
Click on your profile picture to open the menu
Click on "Upload new project"
Fill in the data as requested
And finally in the "Upload" section click on the "Upload files" button
The Windows Explorer folder manager will open
Navigate to the folder where the exe file generated by RMVXAce is located
Select to confirm and wait for the upload bar to load
When finished it will show a new menu where you must select the type of operating system that the game can run, select only Windows
Fill in the rest of the form and go to the end of the page where you can save your project
Your game must be less than 1GB which is the same as 1024 MBytes, because it is an imposed limit, and it is also rare for players to download RPG Maker games larger than 700MB.
